question_evidence_quote: how much longer will it take to fill 12 barrels of soda than on a normal day when the machine works fine?
observed_error: The response subtracts the leak filling time from the normal filling time when calculating the additional time.
violated_condition: Additional filling time requires leak time minus normal time, rather than normal time minus leak time.
error_description: The response calculates the extra time per barrel as 3 minutes minus 5 minutes, reversing the subtraction required by “how much longer.” The arithmetic is executed correctly, but the relation gives the opposite sign. This propagates to the negative numerical answer, although the closing sentence correctly describes a longer duration.
